case_name: Smt. Nidhi Kumari vs Sh. Archit Bhartiya
author: Vikram Nath

paragraphs.text:
CIVIL ORIGINAL JURISDICTION

 IA No. 126399/2021

 Transfer Petition (Civil) No.1427/2018

 SMT. NIDHI KUMARI Petitioner

 VERSUS

 SH. ARCHIT BHARTIYA Respondent

 O R D E R
Learned counsel for the applicant states that he has

 instructions to withdraw the Transfer Petition for which he has

 also moved I.A. No. 126399 of 2021.
Accordingly, the said application is allowed and the Transfer

 Petition is dismissed as withdrawn.
.................................J.
 [VIKRAM NATH]

 NEW DELHI;
NOVEMBER 12, 2021
